title: All Achievements Challenge
description: Gather All Achievements in Minecraft randomly! You can only get one achievement at a time, which one is chosen randomly.
body:
A chaotic advancement challenge where Minecraft decides the order, and you have to follow it. Complete the shown advancement, move to the next one, and race the timer while the bossbar keeps everyone locked on the current goal. 

![A Minecraft World is being displayed, there is a green Bossbar at the top of the screen, which is showing the current Achievement to be achieved and the count. Over the Hotbar is a green timer, which is showing the time in years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes and seconds.. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1760c561e6c3fee150713da361c7cf20d4426ac3_0.webp)

```
/ra start
```
Starts a new challenge. Creates a new random advancement order, resets progress and timer, and revokes previous vanilla advancements.

```
/ra pause true
```
Pauses the challenge. The timer stops and advancements cannot be completed.

```
/ra pause false
```
Resumes the challenge. The timer continues and the current advancement can be completed again.

```
/ra skip
```
Skips the current advancement and moves to the next one.

```
/ra status
```
Shows current progress, timer, and pause state.

```
/ra timer seconds <seconds>
```
Sets the timer to a specific amount of seconds.

```
/ra timer hms <hours> <minutes> <seconds>
```
Sets the timer using hours, minutes, and seconds.

```
/ra timer full <years> <months> <weeks> <days> <hours> <minutes> <seconds>
```
Sets the timer using all time units.

```
/ra color timer <startHex> <endHex>
```
Changes the timer gradient color.

```
/ra color bossbar <color>
```
Changes the bossbar color.
